title: The Roof-Post Invitation Flight
premise: Ada and Pip, a young dragon, want to invite the roof-garden neighbors to a moonmelon party. Three starting conditions can turn the delivery into different adventures: a gust has pinned the invitations to the roof post, the invitations are packed in a basket of delicate paper lanterns, or Pip believes Ada secretly wants a grand dragon-flight delivery. Their choices change what gets delivered, who owns the plan, and what the roof garden finally becomes.
cast_and_props: Characters: Ada, a quick-handed child who wants the invitations to arrive neatly; Pip, a young dragon who wants to help in a spectacular way; and Jun, a neighbor who can receive the invitations and join the final celebration. Setting: one roof garden with a tall roof post, a moonmelon trellis, and a little party table. Props: three paper invitations, a wicker basket, a blue ribbon, a paper lantern, and a tiny brass bell. All state keys use the entity IDs ada, pip, jun, post, invites, basket, ribbon, lantern, bell, garden.
kernels_and_interactions: Kernel families: (1) desire and belief: Ada's aim can be 'neat' or 'spectacular'; Pip's wish can be 'carry' or 'fly'; beliefs travel through observe and tell, but remain stale until shared. (2) access and ownership: Ada owns the basket, Pip can transfer the ribbon or invitations only after receiving them, and Jun can accept a delivered invitation. (3) fragile preparation: the basket's paper-lantern safety changes when it is carried, tied, or opened. (4) physical route: invitations can be pinned to post, carried in basket, or tied to the trellis. (5) performance and response: Pip's flap, bell-ringing, or quiet landing changes whether Jun joins the party and whether the garden becomes decorated. Inciting actions establish the problem first: Ada observes the pinned invitations; Pip lifts the basket before learning it contains a lantern; or Pip tells Ada he knows a marvelous flying route, revealing a mistaken belief. Shared scenes include Ada and Pip discussing the plan, transferring the blue ribbon, Jun receiving an invitation, and the final bell scene. The three problems resolve differently: a wind-tossed invitation becomes a ribboned message on the roof post; the fragile-basket problem becomes a careful lantern-lit delivery; the mistaken-belief problem becomes Pip's first agreed performance, with Jun accepting the invitation from the air. No abstract counters are used.
seed_parameters: Use seed index/seed to choose initial scalar facts, not a branch route. Example seed mapping: wind_level = rng.randrange(2); cargo = ('lantern', 'plain')[rng.randrange(2)]; pip_belief = ('Ada wants a flight', 'Ada wants a quiet walk')[rng.randrange(2)]. Recommended premise_keys: post.invites_pinned, basket.contains_lantern, pip.believes_flight. Declare every slot before scenes. Suggested initial state: ada.memes.Curiosity=2, ada.want='neat', ada.knows.post.invites_pinned=None, ada.knows.basket.contains_lantern=None, ada.knows.pip.believes_flight=None, pip.want='help', pip.belief='quiet', pip.believes_flight=False, post.invites_pinned=True, post.ribboned=False, basket.contains_lantern=True, basket.safe=True, basket.owner='ada', invites.location='post', invites.delivered=False, invites.route='unknown', invites.owner='ada', ribbon.owner='ada', ribbon.used=False, lantern.lit=False, bell.rung=False, garden.party_ready=False, jun.invited=False, jun.knows.invites.delivered=None. Distinct outcome_keys: invites.route, basket.safe, pip.performance_agreed. Goal can be garden.party_ready == True. Build 15 candidates using scene/observe/tell/transfer: observe_pin, observe_cargo, observe_belief; tell_plan; lift_basket; set_down_basket; tie_ribbon; transfer_ribbon; pin_invites; carry_to_trellis; light_lantern; tell_pip_quiet; agree_flight (pivotal); flap_delivery; jun_accepts; ring_bell. Guards should require the relevant observed belief, ownership, location, or agreement. Use max_uses=1; mark only agree_flight and jun_accepts pivotal. Use prune=True. The three route outcomes should be: invites.route='post', basket.safe=True, pip.performance_agreed=False; invites.route='lantern', basket.safe=True, lantern.lit=True; or invites.route='flight', pip.performance_agreed=True, pip.performance='airmail'.

```python
import random
from runtime import WorldSpec, Condition as C, Rule, scene, observe, tell, transfer

def build(seed):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    entities={'ada':{'name':'Ada','kind':'child'},'pip':{'name':'Pip','kind':'dragon'},'jun':{'name':'Jun','kind':'neighbor'},'post':{'name':'roof post','kind':'place'},'basket':{'name':'wicker basket','kind':'prop'},'invites':{'name':'invitations','kind':'prop'},'ribbon':{'name':'blue ribbon','kind':'prop'},'lantern':{'name':'paper lantern','kind':'prop'},'bell':{'name':'brass bell','kind':'prop'},'garden':{'name':'roof garden','kind':'place'}}
    initial={'ada.memes.Curiosity':2,'ada.want':'neat','ada.knows.post.invites_pinned':None,'ada.knows.basket.contains_lantern':None,'ada.knows.pip.believes_flight':None,'pip.want':'help','pip.belief':'quiet','pip.believes_flight':rng.choice((False,True)),'post.invites_pinned':True,'post.ribboned':False,'basket.contains_lantern':rng.choice((True,False)),'basket.safe':True,'basket.owner':'ada','invites.location':'post','invites.delivered':False,'invites.route':'unknown','invites.owner':'ada','ribbon.owner':'ada','ribbon.used':False,'lantern.lit':False,'bell.rung':False,'garden.party_ready':False,'jun.invited':False,'jun.knows.invites.delivered':None,'pip.performance_agreed':False,'pip.performance':'none'}
    scenes=(
      observe('observe_pin','ada','post.invites_pinned',requires=(C('ada.memes.Curiosity','ge',1),),summary='Ada saw the invitations pinned to the post'),
      observe('observe_cargo','ada','basket.contains_lantern',summary='Ada peeked into the basket'),
      observe('observe_belief','ada','pip.believes_flight',summary='Ada noticed Pip planning a flight'),
      tell('tell_plan','ada','pip','ada.want',requires=(),summary='Ada told Pip what sort of delivery she wanted'),
      scene('lift_basket','Carry',('pip',),when=(C('basket.owner','eq','ada'),C('pip.belief','eq','quiet')),set_values={'basket.owner':'pip'},summary='Pip lifted the basket'),
      transfer('transfer_ribbon','ada','pip','ribbon',when=(C('ribbon.owner','eq','ada'),),summary='Ada handed Pip the blue ribbon'),
      scene('tie_ribbon','Tie',('pip',),when=(C('ribbon.owner','eq','pip'),C('post.invites_pinned','eq',True)),set_values={'post.ribboned':True,'ribbon.used':True},summary='Pip tied the pinned invitations with the ribbon'),
      scene('pin_invites','Pin',('ada',),when=(C('ada.knows.post.invites_pinned','eq',True),C('post.ribboned','eq',False)),set_values={'invites.location':'post','invites.route':'post','invites.delivered':True},summary='Ada secured the invitations on the roof post'),
      scene('set_down_basket','SetDown',('pip',),when=(C('basket.owner','eq','pip'),),set_values={'basket.owner':'ada'},summary='Pip set the basket down'),
      scene('carry_to_trellis','Carry',('ada',),when=(C('basket.owner','eq','ada'),C('basket.contains_lantern','eq',True),C('basket.safe','eq',True)),set_values={'invites.location':'trellis','invites.route':'lantern','invites.delivered':True},summary='Ada carried the invitations beneath the trellis'),
      scene('light_lantern','Light',('ada',),when=(C('invites.route','eq','lantern'),),set_values={'lantern.lit':True},summary='Ada lit the paper lantern'),
      tell('tell_pip_quiet','ada','pip','ada.want',summary='Ada explained the quiet plan'),
      scene('agree_flight','Turn',('pip',),when=(C('pip.believes_flight','eq',True),C('ada.want','eq','neat')),set_values={'pip.performance_agreed':True,'pip.performance':'airmail'},pivotal=True,summary='Pip changed his plan to a promised little air-mail performance'),
      scene('flap_delivery','Fly',('pip',),when=(C('pip.performance_agreed','eq',True),C('ribbon.owner','eq','pip')),set_values={'invites.location':'trellis','invites.route':'flight','invites.delivered':True,'ribbon.used':True},summary='Pip flew the invitations to the trellis'),
      scene('jun_accepts','Welcome',('jun',),when=(C('invites.delivered','eq',True),),set_values={'jun.invited':True},pivotal=True,summary='Jun accepted the invitation'),
      scene('ring_bell','Finish',('ada',),when=(C('jun.invited','eq',True)),set_values={'bell.rung':True,'garden.party_ready':True},summary='Ada rang the little bell')
    )
    return WorldSpec('The Roof-Post Invitation Flight',entities,initial,scenes,goal=(C('garden.party_ready','eq',True),),rules=(),labels={'post.ribboned':'the invitations wore a blue ribbon','basket.safe':'the basket stayed safe','invites.route':'the delivery route','pip.performance':'Pip’s performance'},prune=True,premise_keys=('post.invites_pinned','basket.contains_lantern','pip.believes_flight'),outcome_keys=('invites.route','basket.safe','pip.performance_agreed'))
```
constraints: Return executable Python plus a JSON prose catalog. Keep 12–22 candidates and 5–10 selected events. Every state value is scalar and every key begins with an existing entity ID. Do not add location or knowledge without declaring it. Use no branch-number route selection, abstract counters, runtime LLM, or mind-reading. The inciting observation or belief must happen before any response. Guard transfer by ownership and guard dialogue by available knowledge. Reuse observe/tell, ribbon transfer, Jun's acceptance, and bell ringing across materially different paths. Keep Ada and Pip affectionate and playful; Pip is never treated as a machine or a broken device.
different_endings: Catalog openings: two variants, one beginning with Ada finding invitations pinned high on the post, one with Ada discovering the lantern nestled among the invitations. A third conditional opening may mention Pip's mistaken belief only after observe_belief. Every scene needs a card, including unseen preview paths. Beat cards: observe_pin reveals exactly that the wind pinned the invitations; observe_cargo reveals the lantern; tell_plan gives Ada's actual wish; lift_basket has Pip say, “I can carry a basket without tickling it!”; tie_ribbon makes the post look dressed; pin_invites has Ada choose the neat post delivery; carry_to_trellis describes the safe lantern route; light_lantern makes a warm glow; agree_flight is the pivotal exchange where Pip learns Ada wanted neatness, then promises air-mail; flap_delivery describes three invitations floating down on the blue ribbon; jun_accepts has Jun call the delivery splendid; ring_bell is brief. Bridge cards cover setting down the basket and ordinary walking. Endings must be guarded by final facts and have two variants each: route post: the ribboned invitations flutter on the roof post while Jun climbs up laughing; route lantern: the lit lantern glows under the trellis and the invitations rest safely beside its moon-shaped handle; route flight: the blue ribbon loops through the air as Pip lands beside Jun, who holds the invitation like a tiny flag. Each ending ends on an image rather than an explanation. Lexicon entries should define complete phrases for invites.route values post ('on the ribboned roof post'), lantern ('under the glowing lantern'), flight ('on Pip’s blue-ribbon air-mail'), and pip.performance values none ('without a performance') and airmail ('as a tiny air-mail show'). No ending may claim the lantern was used unless lantern.lit is true, no character may mention Pip’s belief before it is observed, and no prose may say the basket broke or needed repair.
